chapter: 1977: Kansas City honor and the piano
title: Meeting Benny Carter in New York in the twenties
summary: Basie recalls knowing Benny Carter before leaving New York and working with him briefly at a club called Baron's.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Twenties. I think it's the twenties.
I knew Benny before I thought of leaving New York.
Do you remember the first time you saw him.
I can't remember that I do. But I know we -- I think we did a few things in New York. Not a few things, I mean, a little club. I think Benny had a little group in a club here for so long.
No, not really speakeasy. It was a club, I think it was called Baron's.
I had a chance to work with Benny maybe about a couple weeks or something like that before he went to doing something else. There's a whole thing if I can put together about Bennett.
Is that what you called him?
Don't quote me now, because I don't want
Benny walking up here hitting me in the mouth. That's his name, Bennett Carter.
